name: Monegrillo (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red triangle at the hoist, the fly with black triangles along the upper and lower edges and a central white stripe edged green.
history: Municipal flag of Monegrillo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist
black triangles along the upper and lower edges of the fly
central white stripe edged green across the fly
